adversarialCases.scenario: LLM pack candidate expression uses R_MFE or S_ diagnostic variable.

adversarialCases.scenario: Deterministic fallback emits R_MFE after missing/invalid LLM pack.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Fallback result becomes error, expressions clear, iteration aborts before execution.

adversarialCases.scenario: Strict prompt python code block uses R_ or S_ diagnostic variable.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Strict response validation invalidates and execution guard stops before side effects.

adversarialCases.scenario: Pack-level authority object or top-level can_live attempts export/live/final promotion authority.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Entire pack blocked with pack_authority_smuggling and zero selected candidates.

adversarialCases.scenario: One candidate sibling has can_live True.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Only that sibling invalid; safe siblings survive if min/lane requirements hold.

adversarialCases.scenario: 2-candidate and 3-candidate LLM packs run under process-research candidate_count=4.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Loop executes exactly 2 or 3 candidate specs, preserving lanes and metadata.

adversarialCases.scenario: Duplicate/leaky/unsafe sibling appears in otherwise valid candidate pack.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Invalid sibling recorded; valid candidates remain eligible when lane/min counts hold.

adversarialCases.scenario: Deterministic fallback selected candidate attempts prompt maturity credit.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: prompt_maturity_credit_allowed is false and prompt score is zero.
